{{ElectionsOH}}
The '''1994 Ohio Attorney General election''' was held on November 8, 1994, to elect the [[Ohio Attorney General]]. Republican [[Ohio Senate|Ohio State Senator]] [[Betty Montgomery]] narrowly defeated incumbent Democratic Ohio Attorney General [[Lee Fisher]]. With her victory, Betty Montgomery became the first woman to serve as Ohio Attorney General.

== Democratic primary ==
=== Candidates ===
*[[Lee Fisher]], incumbent [[Ohio Attorney General]] (1991–1995)

=== Campaign ===
The Democratic primary was held on May 3, 1994. Fisher won renomination without opposition.

== Republican primary ==
=== Candidates ===
*[[Betty Montgomery]], [[Ohio Senate|Ohio State Senator]] (1989–1995)

=== Campaign ===
The Republican primary was held on May 3, 1994. Montgomery won the Republican nomination unopposed.
